lines.text: Five thousand, seven hundred games. One tab. Nothing to install.
No sign-ups. No waiting. You just press play.
Arcade classics, racing, sandbox worlds, full 3D adventures. Every one of them opens right here.
The web is in here too. Paste a link, and it loads inside the page.
YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Discord. Everything you would normally switch tabs for.
And your music keeps playing the whole time.
It remembers what you played, what you loved, and exactly where you stopped.
Themes, backgrounds, shortcuts. Make it yours.
